start: A workout open, no rest running

steps.action: Look at the watch between sets
user_sees: The exercise name
The set number big, e.g. '3' with 'of 5'
Last time's numbers in grey, e.g. '60 kg × 8'
Today's target in the accent colour when it differs
must_not: Another exercise's numbers
The set number cut off

steps.action: Log the set on the phone
user_sees: The watch moves to the next set within a few seconds
must_not: The watch stuck on the set already done

start: The next set is a warm-up

steps.action: Look at the watch
user_sees: The label itself, e.g. 'Warm-up 1 of 2'
must_not: An empty space where the set number should be

start: First time doing this exercise (no last time), or a phone app older than the next-set lines

steps.action: Look at the watch between sets
user_sees: No last-time line; only what is known, or the phone's one text line
must_not: 'null', an empty 'Last:' line or '0 kg × 0'

start: Today's target is the same as last time's numbers

steps.action: Look at the watch
user_sees: One line with the numbers, not two equal lines
must_not: The same numbers shown twice

steps.action: Finish the last set of the exercise
user_sees: The next exercise and its set 1
must_not: The finished exercise still shown

start: Member who did this exercise last week in another routine

steps.action: Look at the watch between sets
user_sees: Last time's numbers from the last time this exercise was done, in any routine, the same as on the phone
must_not: Numbers that differ from the phone's Previous column

steps.action: On the old version, do "Between sets" up to step 1; update the app; open it and carry on.
user_sees: The journey carries on or starts again cleanly, with nothing lost that was saved
must_not: A crash on first open, a lost or half-saved saved data, or a step that the new version no longer understands

note: Older phone app sends no next-set lines: the fallback text line must show
